# `cube::StartMenuWidget`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [ui](../ui.md) › `cube::StartMenuWidget`

- **Kind:** class, 0x168 bytes
- **Status:** candidate (source: kyubu)
- **Builds:** Cube.exe, Cube.exe only
- **C:** `cube_StartMenuWidget` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("cube_StartMenuWidget", address)`
- **Evidence:** `rtti:cube::StartMenuWidget`, `manual:operator new(0x168) in cube::GameController::GameController`, `xref:cube::StartMenuWidget::draw`

the title screen's menu: no child nodes, it draws its three rows itself (cube::StartMenuWidget::draw). Built on cube::GameController.start_menu_node, size 200 x 100; the rows are 50 px apart, so they reach y 140
